description: This file defines an enum class LocationMode used to represent location permission modes within the app, including predefined modes and a companion object method for parsing from raw string values.

classes.name: LocationMode
classes.description: An enumeration class representing different location permission modes such as Off and WhileUsing, with a companion object providing a method to create an instance from a raw string value.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: A companion object method that takes a raw string, normalizes it, and returns the corresponding LocationMode enum value, defaulting to Off if no match is found.
